objective: Prevent partially written individual portable training artifacts by adopting same-directory atomic publication for the established model definition, class mapping, and best model state_dict while preserving formats, APIs, and the non-transactional three-file bundle contract.
completion_conditions: Every checkpoint verifier returns PASS with checkpoint-baseline scope separated from cumulative Phase-wide context, and no checkpoint exceeds one rework round, one maker continuation, or one transient API retry.

The three established portable training artifacts are each published with same-directory temporary files, completed-byte flush/fsync, and os.replace while retaining their paths, formats, APIs, and individual overwrite semantics.

Failure before publication preserves the affected artifact's previous destination and cleans the helper-created temporary file without claiming rollback or transactionality across the other artifacts.
Claude invocation records preserve requested and canonical model telemetry, all reported modelUsage entries, costs, turns, sessions, and terminal reasons without duplicate cost accumulation.
The fixed CPU workflow and inference compatibility tests pass without actual CUDA, external network, packaging, deployment, or product-service calls.
Phase 8 documentation accurately distinguishes per-file atomicity from a multi-file transaction and makes graduation conditional on fixed tests and the final harness.
The fixed full project harness runs exactly once and passes without protected-file, HEAD, staged-index, out-of-scope worktree, or harness mutation.
The Phase stops after this manifest; no later Phase is executed and no commit, push, or pull request is performed.
